headline: Hasbro (HAS) Stock Still Looks Below Fair Value After A 61% Return
summary: Hasbro stock has delivered a 60.9% return over the past three years, and both its Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate and market multiples currently point to the shares trading at a discount to that underlying value. Over the last three years, Hasbro has returned 60.9%, which means investors are already sitting on solid gains while the valuation still screens as attractive.
